title: 15-Minute Weeknight Board
seo_title: 15-Minute Keto Dinner Board: No-Cook Shopping List
description: A 15-minute no-cook keto dinner board for 4: pepper jack, mozzarella pearls, salami, ham, cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, green olives and basil pesto.
hook: No-cook dinner on a board: a keto weeknight meal for four in about 15 minutes.
why: This board borrows from caprese: mozzarella pearls, cherry tomatoes, fresh basil and jarred pesto, which turns plain mozzarella into something you'd order. Pepper jack and salami add spice and salt.
Rolled deli ham makes it filling, and cucumbers and green olives add crunch and brine. Everything comes ready to eat, so the only work is slicing and arranging.

timeline.what: Take the pepper Jack out of the fridge.
Drain the mozzarella pearls; slice the cucumber.
Halve the tomatoes; spoon out the pesto.
Roll the ham and fold the salami; build the board.

faq.q: What's a quick keto dinner without cooking?
faq.a: A board of mozzarella and pepper jack, salami and rolled ham, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, olives and pesto. It takes about 15 minutes.
Most jarred basil pesto is low in carbs, about 1 to 2 g per tablespoon. Check the label for added sugar.
About 8 g net carbs per serving for four.
